scope: Derive stable operation identity and retry/reconciliation decisions for already-valid Phase 2D tasks. This packet does not dispatch providers, perform retries, reconcile external providers, mutate workflow state, write preference events, call Book admission, cache results, cancel/resume work or execute fresh blind evaluation.
laws: Operation identity is derived from authoritative workflow, source, plan, task, capability, service/operation and exact input/context reference identities; timestamps and retry counters never define logical identity.
Identical authoritative inputs to an idempotent registered service operation reuse the same logical operation identity and idempotency key.
The same idempotency key with changed normalized authoritative inputs is a conflict and must fail closed.

Changed manuscript/source, workflow binding, plan digest, task inputs, context package identity, capability, service or operation creates a new logical operation identity; it is not a retry of the old operation.
Idempotent registered service operations may be classified SAFE_SAME_OPERATION_REPLAY only when the exact operation identity and current source/plan bindings still match.
Non-idempotent registered service operations are never automatically replayed after an unknown outcome.
PROSE.GENERATE_REVISION_CANDIDATE remains non-idempotent; unknown outcome requires RECONCILE_BY_REQUEST_ID before any new generation may be considered.

A reconciliation result proving the prior non-idempotent operation produced no effect may authorize consideration of a NEW_ATTEMPT_AFTER_CONFIRMED_NO_EFFECT, but this packet does not execute that attempt.
A reconciliation result proving an effect exists requires REUSE_OR_REVIEW_EXISTING_RESULT; duplicate generation is forbidden.
An unresolved or contradictory reconciliation result remains RECONCILE_REQUIRED and fails closed.
DECLARED_BLOCKED_CAPABILITY and AUTHORITY_WAIT tasks have no provider retry identity and are classified NOT_EXECUTABLE_BY_RETRY_POLICY.
BOOK_ADMISSION_HANDOFF is outside orchestrator provider-retry authority and is classified BOOK_ADMISSION_RETRY_NOT_AUTHORIZED.
Provider SUCCESS or replay does not imply Book admission or canonical manuscript mutation.
Retry decisions never widen provider authority, bypass author decisions, bypass Story Bible/canon, or convert evaluator evidence into canonical state.
Retry/reconciliation evidence must be referenced by identity; raw manuscript or candidate text is forbidden in retry decision records.
Fresh blind evaluation remains isolation-gated independently of retry safety.

registered_service_policy_source.rule: Read each callable task's registered operation idempotent boolean from this exact qualified registry; no local override may silently change it.
